'''Chris Nicholson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Rancho Cucamonga tournament]] on 15 June 2001 with Yavin 4 deck, according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2496">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01d2496/ longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 21 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01d2496/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
